name: Alex Michelsen
intro: Alex Michelsen is a tall young American from California. He just turned 22. He has a rock-solid backhand and a big serve.
story: At age three, Alex hit backhands against the family garage door. His mom hit with him almost every day. He says she is like a wall! At 18 he skipped college and reached a pro final right away. On Friday he won in straight sets, so he plays again Sunday.

funFacts.text: Both his parents played college tennis. His mom hit with him almost every day.
His favorite movie is Star Wars. His favorite book is Harry Potter.
He loves video games. He plays them against his pal Learner Tien, another player.
He plays basketball for fun and cheers for the Lakers.
His favorite ice cream flavor is plain vanilla.
He won the Wimbledon boys' doubles title in 2022 with his friend Sebastian.

watchFor: Watch his two-handed backhand rip straight down the line for a winner!

notes: Bio (born 25 Aug 2004 Aliso Viejo CA, 6'4"/193 cm, right-handed/two-handed backhand, turned pro 2023 forgoing Georgia, first ATP final at 18, 2022 Wimbledon boys' doubles with Sebastian Gorzny, wins over top-10 players) verified on Wikipedia.
